testcase.system-out: Scenario: Save a new modified part while closing it ✔ Given an unsaved part containing a finished empty sketch is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And save-change prompts are configured to always show ✔ And another document is open ✔ And the proposed file name does not exist in the selected folder ✔ When the user closes the document tab ✔ And the user chooses Yes in the save-changes prompt ✔ And the user accepts the proposed file name in Save As ✔ Then the document closes ✔ And another open document becomes active ✔ When the user reopens the newly saved part in the same session ✔ Then the part becomes active ✔ And its model browser contains the finished sketch
